title: Initial Evaluation of Potential Bias in Coverage of Humans in Wikidata

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating missingness of gender statements, comparing the proportion of male, female, and nonbinary/trans biographies against a 50% parity benchmark using Chi-square tests, and assessing gender representation across different occupational categories.
Comparing the representation of explicit and assumed sexual orientation identities on Wikidata against real-world population baselines derived from Ipsos LGBT+ Pride global surveys.
Comparing the proportion of biographies by country of citizenship (e.g., Western Europe and North America vs. the Global South) against global population shares derived from the UN M49 Geoscheme.

Classifying and analyzing the missingness and representation of rural versus urban birthplaces by intersecting Wikidata coordinates with spatial datasets like the Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL) and GADM.
Measuring the missingness (MAR/MNAR) of ethnic group statements and analyzing the representation and gender-skew of stated ethnic identities (e.g., African American, Han Chinese).
Comparing the stated languages spoken or written by entities, as well as the language coverage of item labels, descriptions, and aliases, against global native speaker population baselines.
